title: Light-Omni: Reflex over Reasoning in Agentic Video Understanding with Long-Term Memory

details.title: Light-Omni: Reflex over Reasoning in Agentic Video Understanding with Long-Term Memory
details.abstract: We introduce Light-Omni, a highly efficient multimodal agent framework for long-term video understanding. Advanced video agents usually suffer from prohibitive latency due to heavy "detective-style" iterative reasoning. To solve this, Light-Omni enables instant "reflexive" responses via a novel dual-state mechanism (Global & Latent states) in a single forward pass. Key Highlights: 🔥 Incredible Efficiency: Achieves a 12.1× speedup and 2.6× GPU memory reduction compared to M3-Agent, with near-constant latency (~2.3s) regardless of video length. 📈 SOTA Performance: Delivers an average accuracy of 64.8% across VideoMME-long, LVBench, and HippoVlog. 🛠️ Plug-and-Play: Acts as a foundational memory system that seamlessly boosts existing MLLMs (e.g., Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL, Gemini-2.0-Flash). Code, models, and dataset are available in our repo!

title: SIEVE: Structure-Aware Data Selection for Imitation Learning with VLA Models

details.title: SIEVE: Structure-Aware Data Selection for Imitation Learning with VLA Models
details.abstract: 🚀 Do VLA models need more data, or better data? We introduce SIEVE , a structure-aware data selection method for VLA imitation learning. Instead of treating demonstrations as isolated trajectories, SIEVE views them as compositions of reusable visuo-motor primitives and transition interfaces . ✨ What SIEVE does: 🔹 discovers reusable primitives from robot trajectories 🔹 allocates data budgets to structurally informative composition patterns 🔹 selects central, stable demonstrations that are easier for behavior cloning to learn from 📊 Results: ✅ Consistently beats strong data selection baselines ✅ Works across multiple datasets, benchmarks, and VLA models ✅ Surpasses full-data training with only 50% data + 50% training steps 💡 Takeaway: For efficient VLA training, selecting reusable behavioral structure can be more important than simply scaling up robot data.
